meta.title: Books | House Pendale
meta.description: Begin the Pendaleverse with When Stars Align and follow the books as the House expands.

hero.title: Every House has a first door.
hero.support: There is a clear place to begin. Start with When Stars Align, the first open door into a world where appetite, structure, and consequence share the same spine.

sections.title: There is a right place to begin.
sections.body: Begin with When Stars Align. Let the world introduce itself in motion. The deeper architecture will meet you when it matters, with clarity first and depth where it counts.

sections.title: The first threshold is already open.
sections.body: When Stars Align follows Dr. Elysia Sinclair into a House that recognizes her before she is ready to recognize herself. If you like your fantasy with bones under the silk, this is the clearest place to step inside.
sections.imageAlt: Hero image for When Stars Align

sections.title: The House is still expanding.
sections.body: More doors are coming. This page leaves room for the shelf to grow without asking the live catalogue to wear a false moustache and pretend it already has a ballroom full of titles.
sections.microcopy: Future books will join the shelf here when they are ready to stand on their own feet.

sections.title: Some things belong beside the books.
sections.body: For release notes, deeper commentary, and companion material that should stay adjacent to the reading path, Substack is where the House keeps speaking after the page ends.
